dashboard.table: Welcome to Castled! This is the game history table. Where you can view and manage every analysis you have made.
dashboard.startAnalysis: Let's analyze a game! Click on the "New Analysis" button to start a new analysis.

startAnalysis.import: Import a game from chess.com, lichess.org or simply copy and pase a PGN into the text area below.
startAnalysis.engine: Select an engine to analyze the game
startAnalysis.engineDownload: Once you selected an engine, you need to download it, large engines may take some time to download.

analysis.controls: You can walk through the moves played during the game using these controls.
analysis.evalBar: This is the evaluation bar. It shows the engine evaluation of the current position.
analysis.moveList: This is the move list panel. It displays the moves played during the game. You can click on a move to jump to that position.
analysis.database: This is the database panel. It displays the ratio of Win/Draw/Loss for each move in the current position based on ~1.5 million games. Hovering over a move will display an arrow on the chessboard to help you visualize it.
analysis.evalHistory: This is the evaluation history panel. It displays the evolution of the engine evaluation over time.
analysis.interpretation: Finally, this is the interpretation panel. It displays additional information about the current position that might be useful for beginners.
